text_block_list.text:
"Today marks the end of the summer 
training camp. Vodka stood alone, gazing 
out at the sea."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...? Oh, Trainer. Is it time for the bus 
already?
choice_data_list: I've still got a bit left, what is it?
I've still got a little left, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I was just looking back on the 
training camp. Thinking about how I 
managed to get through some surprisingly 
steady, grounded training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“—Burst speed. On the beach, mountain 
trails, and narrow field paths... without 
getting distracted, I honed it to the 
limit.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd lose to Scarlett when it 
comes to patience, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why I was able to push myself so 
hard without ever getting tired of it?
choice_data_list:
Because you were polishing your cool 
factor?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Honing coolness... I see. That is true...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The whole time I was doing it, I kept 
thinking, 'If my acceleration goes up, 
I'll be way cooler!'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, it's no big deal. Giving it your 
all isn't about forcing yourself to endure 
stuff..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Find something you can put your all 
into." Maybe that's all there is to it.

Standing side by side, the two of us 
looked up at the late-summer sky.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, I found it too. Something I can 
truly be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to unleash this on 
you. The number one."
